newsitem.title: USA: Renal Care holders okay Renalwest merger.
newsitem.headline: Renal Care holders okay Renalwest merger.

text.p: Renal Care Group Inc said on Tuesday its shareholders approved its merger with RENALWEST, an Arizona-based provider of dialysis services and that the deal was expected to be accretive to earnings.
Renal Care said in a statement the transaction would take the form of a tax-free stock swap and would be treated as a pooling-of-interests for accounting purposes.
Renal Care said it issued about 2.4 million additional common shares to complete the transaction.
Sam A. Brooks, Jr., president and chief executive officer, said in a statement: "The merger increases the number of patients we provide dialysis services to by 34 percent."

"This transaction represents Renal Care Group's entry into the Southwest U.S. market," he said. "Effective with this merger, we will now be operating an additional 19 outpatient dialysis centers and three centers providing home dialysis care to patients in the Metro Phoenix area and rural Arizona."
Renal Care Group is a nephrology services company focused on providing care to patients with kidney disease, including those suffering from chronic kidney failure.
